description: Offre de transport du réseau Proxim iTi (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Syndicat Mixte des 4 Communautés de communes. Schedules, routes, stops of the Proxim iTi network. Coverage: Syndicat Mixte des 4 Communautés de communes. The portal shows the English title as "Proxim iTi Network Transport Offer (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Syndicat Mixte des 4 Communautés de communes. Its keywords include haute-savoie, autocar, valleedelarve, proximiti, interurbain. The listing shows 2024-10-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
